How do I get a musty smell out of my car?





The fastest way to eliminate a musty smell is to find and dry the moisture source, then deep‑clean carpets and seats and disinfect the AC system, which is a common cause of mildew odors.
✅ Why Your Car Smells Musty
Most musty odors come from trapped moisture, which leads to mildew or mold. Common sources include:
Wet carpets or floor mats from spills or rain 
2
Clogged sunroof or door seals letting water in 
1
Condensation in the AC evaporator causing “gym‑sock” smells 
2
Dirty cabin air filter recirculating mold spores
